'''''Star Wars: Sana Starros''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries written by [[Justina Ireland]] and illustrated by [[Pere Pérez]]. The [[Sana Starros 1|first issue]] was published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[February 1]], [[2023]].
